Hero262.heading: More than an SEO provider
Hero262.subheading: Your business is never just another number.
Hero262.description:
When you trust us with your website, you also trust us with the goals, ideas and ambitions behind it. We take that responsibility seriously. We learn how your business works, understand where you want to go and become an active part of the team working to get you there.

We celebrate your growth because we know what it took to achieve it. We investigate when something is not working, adapt when priorities change and continue looking for new opportunities even when they fall outside the original plan.

Our role is not simply to complete a monthly list of SEO tasks. It is to understand what your business needs next and help make it happen.

FounderLetter.heading: From the Owner
FounderLetter.quote:
Conversion Century is much more than a company to me. I have grown alongside it, dedicated my professional life to SEO and built a team of people who care about our clients as deeply as I do. That is why I remain personally involved in every business that places its trust in us.

When we take on a client, I want to understand what they are building, why it matters and what success would mean for their company. Their website becomes something I think about, question and genuinely want to improve, not simply another project in a report.

That commitment also requires honesty. We accept projects where we believe we can create meaningful value, and we expect trust, responsiveness and dedication from our clients in return. Our best results happen when both teams care about the outcome and work toward the same goal.
FounderLetter.name: Maria Sivkova
FounderLetter.role: Owner and Managing Director, Conversion Century

Testimonial17.heading: What our clients say about working with us

hero.heading: A Focused Team. A Shared Commitment to Your Growth.
hero.body:
Conversion Century is a boutique SEO agency based in Sofia, Bulgaria, working with businesses across Europe and the United States.

Since 2016, we have combined technical expertise, professional content and strategic thinking to help businesses strengthen their organic presence. Today, that work spans search engines and AI-powered discovery, with the same focus: connecting your business with people who need what you offer.

2016.title: A Dedicated SEO Agency Takes Shape
2016.content: Conversion Century was founded in February 2016 by Nick Gerdzhikov in Bulgaria. From the beginning, the agency focused specifically on SEO, bringing research, website optimisation, content and link building together around clients’ business goals.

2017.title: Our First Steps Into the United States
2017.content: We began working with clients in the US, expanding our experience beyond Bulgaria. These projects introduced new competitive environments and helped shape our approach to working across markets.

2018.title: Larger Clients and Local Partnerships
2018.content: Our Bulgarian portfolio grew to include larger, established businesses. We also built relationships with local agencies, contributing specialist SEO expertise to broader marketing and website projects.

2019.title: Supporting European Expansion
2019.content: We entered more European markets alongside Bulgarian brands looking to grow internationally. Understanding local search demand and adapting websites for different audiences became an increasingly important part of our work.

2020.title: A Growing Business and a New Team Member
2020.content: The agency continued to grow, developing its client relationships and delivery processes. Maria Sivkova joined as an intern, beginning a journey that would take her from learning the agency’s methods to leading its next chapter.

2021.title: Our First Sofia Office
2021.content: We opened our first physical office in Sofia, creating a shared space for collaboration and learning. Alongside our international work, we invested in documenting processes and turning practical experience into knowledge the whole team could use.

2022.title: New Ownership, Continued Ambition
2022.content:
When Nick moved to the United States, Maria acquired Conversion Century and became its new owner.

We continued strengthening our international presence, developing our internal methods and building our partnership with MUZE. This brought our SEO expertise closer to complementary creative, marketing and influencer capabilities.

2023.title: Bringing Our Expertise Together
2023.content: We continued refining how research, technical SEO, content and authority building work together. Our focus was on clearer priorities, stronger coordination and long-term relationships with clients and agency partners.

2024.title: Investing in Tools and International Education
2024.content: We became official partners of Ahrefs and Semrush and expanded international SEO training across the team. Continued education helped us build a shared foundation while giving specialists room to deepen their individual expertise.

2025.title: A More Specialised Team
2025.content: Our team reached 10 people, with a clearer structure across SEO specialists, content managers, copywriters and technical SEO specialists. This strengthened both specialist ownership and collaboration across client projects.

2026.title: Our Strongest Year Yet
2026.content:
Our tenth year has been our strongest so far, with a growing client portfolio and a clear direction for the future.

We are developing our approach to AI search visibility, testing new tools and adapting our methods as discovery changes. Alongside that work, we continue investing in the technical foundations, content quality and commercial understanding that support lasting organic performance.

people.heading: The People Behind the Work
people.lead: Our team brings together SEO specialists, technical specialists, content managers and professional copywriters.
people.body:
We work closely across disciplines because a website’s performance depends on how its parts connect. Search research informs content. Technical decisions affect discovery. Clear product and service information helps visitors evaluate an offer and take action.

Clients have direct access to the people responsible for their work, including the owner and senior content expertise. Within the team, we share findings, review important decisions and support each other’s development.

leadership.heading: Led by Maria Sivkova
leadership.intro:
Maria joined Conversion Century in 2020 and became its owner in 2022. With more than eight years of experience across HR, marketing and digital, she brings an understanding of both people and business to her leadership.

Today, she leads the agency’s strategy and development, supports the team’s growth and stays closely involved in client relationships.

markets.heading: Based in Sofia. Working Across Borders.
markets.lead: We support Bulgarian businesses expanding internationally and international companies building their presence in Bulgaria and other European markets.

collaboration.heading: Close Collaboration. Shared Ambition.
collaboration.lead: We believe good work starts with knowing the business behind the website.
collaboration.body:
Your customers, commercial priorities and ambitions shape our approach. We take time to understand what you are building, where you want to go and what could stand in the way. That understanding guides the research, recommendations and everyday decisions we make on your behalf.

Our team is deliberately small, with experienced specialists working closely together. This gives us room for direct communication, shared responsibility and meaningful involvement in each client’s story.

We bring energy, curiosity and a strong commitment to improving our craft. You work with people who care about the details, take ownership of their work and want to see your business move forward.

mission.statement: To help businesses build a lasting, commercially valuable presence wherever their customers search.
mission.body:
We make complex search challenges easier to understand and act on. Through research, technical improvements, useful content and relevant authority, we help clients turn their expertise, products and services into opportunities for growth.

Success means attracting the right people and helping them take a meaningful next step — an enquiry, a consultation, an application or a purchase.

understand.title: Understand Before Recommending
understand.content: We investigate your business, audience and website before deciding what needs to change. Recommendations should reflect your situation, resources and opportunities.

ownership.title: Take Ownership
ownership.content: We follow through on our responsibilities, raise issues early and stay involved as recommendations move into implementation. We care about what happens after a task is delivered.

communicate.title: Communicate Clearly
communicate.content: You should understand what we are doing, why it matters and how we will evaluate progress. We share findings openly, explain limitations and have honest conversations about priorities.

longTerm.title: Build for the Long Term
longTerm.content: We use white-hat SEO methods and focus on useful content, accessible websites and relevant authority. Our work should strengthen your business presence over time.

learning.title: Keep Learning and Testing
learning.content: Search changes, and our methods need to develop with it. We invest in education, share knowledge and evaluate new tools critically before making them part of our work.

partners.title: Work as Partners
partners.content: We value the knowledge your team brings. Some of our client relationships span more than seven years, built through collaboration, consistency and a shared commitment to progress.
